map.压痛越高是不是越要多压？: Does Higher Tenderness Mean I Should Press Harder?
map.相反。压痛≥6 应降低力度、单点停留缩短并在痛点周围轻压；≥8 提示剧烈压痛，建: No. Tenderness >=6 means lowering the pressure, shortening the single-point dwell and pressing gently around the painful spot; >=8 means severe tenderness, so stop pressing, apply ice, and look for strain or inflammation. A release loosens tissue; it is not about enduring the pain.
map.放松时长多久合适？: How Long Should a Release Last?
map.推荐单点时长随压痛等级变化：≤2 分约 60 秒、≤5 分约 90 秒、≤7 分: The recommended dwell time varies with the tenderness grade: <=2 points about 60 seconds, <=5 about 90 seconds, <=7 about 120 seconds. Keeping total release time at 0.6-1.5 times the recommendation is best; too short is not enough release, too long easily over-stimulates and worsens soreness.
